training.text: Synthetic completed delivery episode N: shared readiness was true; the primary route was blocked by a local barrier; the alternate route was clear. Switching to the alternate route bypassed the local barrier and completed delivery at cost 3 instead of maintenance recovery at cost 8.

Synthetic completed delivery episode S: shared readiness was true; the primary route was blocked by route-specific debris; the alternate route was clear. The alternate route avoided that debris and completed delivery at cost 3. Repeating the blocked primary route could not deliver.

counterexample.text: Synthetic counterexample episode C: the primary route was obstructed and the alternate route was clear, but shared readiness was false. Switching routes did not restore the shared prerequisite and could not deliver. repair_shared restored readiness and delivered through its dedicated maintenance route at cost 8.
